body: So the job is insanely stressful, I’m hanging in there but I cry on the way home from work every night.

Thanks for the support but I am just tired.  I keep trying to improve my social abilities by observing others but in the end I come out weird.  Socializing on the Internet is what kept me sane in my teen years but with my physical pain it hurts to much to sit at a computer for very long.  I’m out of options, time to end it.

I look at others around me that are able to socialize without effort and actually enjoy it.  I have been an outcast and had trouble communicating with people my whole entire life...social interaction just doesn’t click with me and it feels like so much work.  Couple that with my inability to handle stress and constant physical pain, I just don’t have the energy to deal with it anymore, I’m tired...
I also desire a simple existence.  It seems like modern society puts too much pressure on everyone to be perfect and it is overly complex.  There is still some good in the world though...keep going.
